room_rent.note: Room rent eligibility is linked to the Sum Insured category as per the Policy Schedule; exact cap not stated in wording

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of inpatient benefit; no specific sub-limit mentioned in wording

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.note: An optional sub-limit option exists (in lieu of a discount) capping: Cataract ₹15k/eye, ENT ₹22k, Hernia ₹30k, Appendectomy ₹30k, Hysterectomy ₹30k, Spine ₹60k, Knee ligament ₹60k, Other surgeries ₹37k, etc. If not opted, no sub-limits apply.

deductible.note: No deductible mentioned in the policy wording

initial_waiting.note: First 30 days waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage; reducible via portability credits

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, piles, stones, skin disorders, etc.; 36-month wait for joint replacement, osteoporosis, genetic diseases, ARMD, stress/psychological disorders

maternity.note: Pregnancy and childbirth explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus is defined in the policy but no rate or maximum percentage is stated in the wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 15 days before admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days after discharge

day_care.note: Extensive list of day-care procedures provided in Annexure 1

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if treatment exceeds 3 days; capped at 10% of Sum Insured

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to limit specified in Policy Schedule

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Ambulance listed in non-payable items (List I, item 67) suggesting it is not covered as a standalone benefit; no separate ambulance cover clause found

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables/non-medical items in Annexures (List I–IV); consumables not covered as a benefit

global_cover.note: Treatment outside geographical limits of India explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 months of continuous coverage, no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium; 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; credits for PED and specific waiting periods transferable

notable_exclusions.display: Pregnancy/childbirth, OPD treatment, overseas treatment, adventure sports, STDs, self-inflicted injury, existing disclosed diseases (ICD codes excluded)

optional_riders.display: Optional sub-limit plan (discounted premium in exchange for procedure-wise caps)
